defects.description: Headers were left untranslated in English.
The translation incorrectly states that the operator is the one asking for a decision, whereas the source states the operator is being asked to make the decision.
The glossary term 'Subject' (Объект обсуждения) was translated as 'объект'.
'Runtime' (referring to the execution environment/system) was mistranslated as 'Время выполнения' (referring to the duration of execution).
